title: Assistant Director-Corporate Credit Origination Project Manager
description:
Job Description

**Job purpose**

We are seeking a senior Corporate Credit Origination Project Manager with strong corporate and commercial lending domain expertise and hands-on experience managing technology-enabled credit-origination initiatives.

The selected candidate will take end-to-end ownership of the remediation and enhancement of an existing corporate credit-origination platform. The role requires a strong techno-functional professional who can assess implementation gaps, define a practical remediation roadmap, and drive execution across business, credit, operations, risk, compliance, and technology teams. The candidate will be based onsite in Bahrain and must be capable of independently engaging senior stakeholders, challenging existing approaches, resolving crossfunctional issues, and driving the initiative to successful completion.

**Key responsibilities**

Corporate Credit Origination and Domain

Lead the end-to-end remediation and enhancement of the bank’s existing corporate credit-origination platform and associated processes.

Assess current credit-origination workflows, identify implementation gaps, determine root causes, and define a prioritized remediation roadmap.

Review and improve the end-to-end corporate lending lifecycle, including credit application, assessment, approval, documentation, limit setup, disbursement readiness, renewals, amendments, and monitoring.

Ensure platform workflows align with the bank’s credit policies, approval authorities, risk controls, regulatory requirements, and operating procedures.

Identify process inefficiencies, manual interventions, control gaps, approval delays, and user-adoption challenges, and recommend practical improvements.

Facilitate workshops with relationship management, credit, risk, operations, legal, compliance, and creditadministration teams to finalize business requirements and priorities.

Define and track measurable improvements in credit turnaround time, workflow efficiency, control effectiveness, exception management, and user adoption.

**Technology and Techno-Functional Delivery**

Translate credit-domain and operational requirements into process maps, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technology deliverables.

Review the existing solution design, configuration, workflows, business rules, approval matrices, and makerchecker controls to identify remediation requirements.

Coordinate platform integrations with core banking, customer, risk-rating, collateral, documentmanagement, limit-management, and reporting systems.

Oversee data assessment, mapping, cleansing, migration, reconciliation, and correction activities required to improve platform data quality.

Work with technical teams to investigate platform issues using system logs, database queries, SQL-based analysis, interface monitoring, and defect reports.

Lead system integration testing, user acceptance testing, regression testing, defect prioritization, and testexit approvals.

Oversee release planning, cutover, production deployment, stabilization, and post-implementation support.

Ensure the solution meets information-security, role-based access, segregation-of-duties, audit-trail, dataprivacy, and technology-control requirements.

Manage technology vendors and system integrators, ensuring clear deliverables, ownership, quality standards, and adherence to agreed timelines.

**Program Leadership and Governance**

Take end-to-end ownership of the initiative and drive execution across business, credit, operations, risk, technology, and vendor teams.

Develop and manage the project plan covering scope, milestones, budget, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, and success measures.

Establish governance forums and provide clear progress updates, risk assessments, remediation status, and decision requirements to senior management.

Resolve cross-functional issues, remove delivery roadblocks, manage scope changes, and escalate critical risks requiring executive intervention.

Drive stakeholder communication, business readiness, user training, change management, and adoption across impacted teams.

Ensure complete documentation and effective handover to business, operations, technology-support, and platform-ownership teams.

**Key competencies**

10+ years of overall experience in banking, financial services, consulting, or banking technology, with substantial experience in corporate or commercial lending.

Strong understanding of the end-to-end corporate credit lifecycle, including:

* Customer and borrower onboarding

* Credit application and proposal preparation

* Financial and non-financial assessment

* Credit analysis and risk grading

* Collateral and covenant management

* Credit approval and delegated authority workflows

* Documentation and drawdown readiness

* Annual reviews, renewals, amendments, and monitoring

Proven experience leading the implementation, enhancement, remediation, or transformation of corporate credit-origination platforms and processes.

Strong knowledge of corporate and commercial lending products, credit policies, approval structures, risk controls, and credit administration processes.

Experience identifying process and system gaps in an existing implementation and converting the findings into an executable remediation roadmap.

Experience working with relationship managers, credit analysts, credit risk teams, operations teams, and technology delivery teams.

Strong hands-on understanding of the following technology areas is essential

* Corporate credit-origination systems, lending platforms, workflow solutions, or credit lifecycle applications.

* Business-process and workflow configuration, including approval routing, maker-checker controls, exception handling, escalations, and delegated authority matrices.

* System integration concepts, including APIs, web services, middleware, batch interfaces, and integration with core banking, customer, risk, collateral, document-management, and reporting systems.

* Data mapping, data migration, data reconciliation, data-quality assessment, and referencedata management.

* Functional requirements, process maps, user stories, acceptance criteria, solution-design reviews, and traceability matrices.

* SQL and database concepts, with the ability to work with technical teams during data analysis, reconciliation, troubleshooting, and defect investigation.

* Testing lifecycle management, including system integration testing, user acceptance testing, regression testing, defect management, and test-exit criteria.

* Release, cutover, production deployment, stabilization, and post-implementation support processes.

* Role-based access, information security, audit trails, segregation of duties, and technology controls relevant to banking platforms.

* Reporting and dashboard requirements for credit pipeline, approval status, turnaround time, exceptions, limits, covenants, and portfolio monitoring.

* Agile, waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies and associated project-management tools.

Strong ownership and accountability, with the ability to independently drive a complex, bank-wide initiative.

Ability to bridge the gap between credit-domain stakeholders and technology delivery teams.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly in diagnosing implementation and process issues.

Excellent stakeholder-management, facilitation, negotiation, and conflict-resolution capabilities.

A master’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Technology, or a related field

title: Technology Program Manager
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
We have an immediate need for a seasoned Technical Program Manager in Bengaluru. The profile we’re seeking calls for 15–20 years of corporate experience, with proven leadership in technical program management within large-scale software engineering environments.
  
  
Below is a comprehensive job description outlining key requirements and expectations.
  
  
1. Strategic Program & Transformation Leadership
  
**Program Governance:** Establish and maintain organizational standards for program delivery, ensuring that technical excellence, security-by-design, and operational reliability are embedded in every project.
  
**Cloud-Native Evolution:** Lead the transition from legacy monolithic systems to modern, cloud-native architectures (Microservices, Serverless, Containerization). Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of cloud migrations and optimizations.
  
**Data Transformation Initiatives:** Strategize and execute complex data engineering programs, including the implementation of real-time streaming pipelines, data lakehouse architectures, and large-scale data migrations to support AI/ML and analytics.
  
2. Engineering Operations & Governance
  
**Operating Mechanisms:** Establish and refine the "Rhythm of Business" (RoB) for the engineering organization, including monthly operational reviews, quarterly planning (OKRs), and executive status reporting.
  
**Resource & Capacity Modeling:** Lead complex capacity planning exercises to ensure engineering talent is aligned with the highest-priority strategic initiatives.
  
**Agile Maturity:** Acting as a "Coach of Coaches," elevating the maturity of Agile practices across distributed teams. Standardize Scrum frameworks while allowing for team-level autonomy.
  
**Ceremony Excellence:** Supporting high-stakes ceremonies, including multi-team Big Room Planning, Scrum-of-Scrums, and AI-augmented Backlog Refinement sessions to identify cross-program dependencies.
  
**Incident Governance:** Partner with SRE and DevOps teams to define and enforce Incident Management protocols. Oversee the lifecycle of critical (P0/P1) incidents, ensuring rapid restoration of services.
  
**Post-Mortem Culture:** Enabling a "blame-free" post-mortem culture. Ensure that Root Cause Analysis (RCA) leads to actionable backlog items that prevent recurrence and improve system hardening.
  
3. Cross-Functional Technical Orchestration
  
**Stakeholder Alignment:** Act as the primary liaison between Engineering, Data Science, Product Management, and Business Operations. Translate complex technical trade-offs into clear business risks and opportunities for executive leadership.
  
**Dependency Management:** Proactively identify and resolve "hidden" bottlenecks across distributed teams. Manage complex interdependencies in multi-cloud and hybrid environments to ensure seamless integration.
  
**Vendor & SaaS Integration:** Orchestrating the technical integration of third-party SaaS platforms and managed services, ensuring they meet internal security, performance, and data governance standards.
  
3. Technical Strategy & Architecture Alignment
  
**Systems Thinking:** Partner with Architects to ensure program milestones align with technical standards. Provide "architectural judgment" to prevent technical debt and ensure scalability.
  
4. Risk Management & Predictive Planning
  
**Advanced Risk Mitigation:** Overseeing proactive risk management framework for zero non-compliance and/or overdues.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
**Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
  
**Experience:** 15–20 years of progressive experience in Technical Program Management, with at least 5 years in a Principal or Lead capacity within a large-scale Software Engineering organization.
  
**Cross-Functional Leadership:** Exceptional ability to influence without authority and build consensus across diverse technical and non-technical stakeholder groups.
  
**Tooling:** Expert-level proficiency with JIRA, Confluence, and advanced roadmap visualization tools. Familiarity with AI-assisted project management tools is a plus.
  
**Soft Skills:** Superior communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills. Ability to maintain clarity and direction in highly ambiguous, fast-paced environments.
  
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

In India, Bosch is a leading supplier of technology and services in the areas of Mobility, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. Technologies Private Limited. Since commencing operations in 1951, we have steadily expanded our footprint across 17 manufacturing sites and 7 development and application centers, supporting both domestic and global markets. These facilities enable us to localize solutions, drive innovation, and respond with speed to dynamic customer and industry requirements. In FY 2024–25, we reported net revenue of 373,457 million INR (approximately euros 4.13 billion) and employed 38,655 associates as of March 31, 2025. Bosch Limited continues to anchor the Group’s India presence with a sharp focus on next-generation mobility, smart manufacturing, and digital transformation. It earned revenue from operations of Rs. 18,087 crores ((1,985 million euros) in fiscal year 2024-25.

 **Job Description**

**Job Summary:**

The **SAP S/4HANA Project Manager** plays a critical role in leading, orchestrating, and successfully delivering enterprise-wide SAP S/4HANA transformation projects (including new implementations and global rollouts) to support Bosch Mobility Aftermarket’s strategic business goals. This individual collaborates closely with executive steering committee, cross-functional business stakeholders, functional consultants, and technical teams to ensure the seamless execution of all project phases—from scoping and design through to cutover and hyper-care—delivering robust, scalable solutions on time and within budget.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* **Project Planning & Scoping:** Define project scope, objectives, milestones, and master project plans in partnership with solution architects and business stakeholders.
* **Methodology Execution:** Apply the SAP Activate Methodology across all phases—Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy, and Run.
* **Resource & Budget Management:** Acquire & allocate cross-functional project resources, manage budgets, track operational costs, and control project burn rates.
* **Risk & Issue Mitigation:** Maintain and monitor risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies and resolving bottlenecks before they impact project delivery.
* **Stakeholder Engagement:** Facilitate governance meetings, steering committee updates, and clear communication loops between executive leadership, business process owners, and technical teams.
* **Quality Gate Management:** Oversee quality assurance criteria, system testing phases (system integration tests and user acceptance tests), and sign-offs across key Quality Gates using tools like SAP Solution Manager or ALM.

* **Cutover & Go-Live Strategy:** Coordinate detailed cutover plans, data migration tasks, hyper-care support transition, and post-go-live issue resolution.
* **People Management:** Strong people management skills to steer the project team towards successful results.

 **Qualifications**

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
* **Experience:**
  + 10+ years of overall IT/SAP ecosystem experience.
  + Minimum of 3–5 full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementation or rollout projects managed in a leadership capacity.
  + Experience in leading global SAP S/4 HANA implementations.
* **Certifications (Preferred):**
  + Project Management Professional (**PMP**)
  + **SAP Activate** Project Manager Certification
  + Agile & Scrum methodology
* **Technical Knowledge:** Strong foundational understanding of core SAP modules (e.g., SD, MM, FICO, EWM, PP) and technical architecture associated with S/4HANA.
* **Tool Proficiency:** Experience with OTALM, SAP Solution Manager, JIRA, Power BI, SAP BTP
* **Soft Skills:** Exceptional leadership, conflict resolution, change management, and executive-level communication abilities, strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience in global SAP S/4 HANA implementations.

  
**Additional Information**

By choice, we are committed to a diverse workforce-EOE/Protected Veteran/Disabled

**Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, including ability to effectively communicate with internal and external customers**

**Job Description**
-------------------

**About Globals:**

Globals has drastically grown from a small home office to a globally recognized enterprise offering world-class quality solutions on Cybersecurity, Cyberwarfare, ERP Systems, AI, and Enterprise Application Development for various industries including Defence, Education, Government, Financial Services and Transport Industries. Globals has enabled its customers to be game-changers in their industry through its disruptive and innovative solutions.

Globals is certified as a **"Great Place to Work"** organization for its laudable work culture that helps its team members manage work-life, have dedicated hours to upskill and reskill themselves, and most important to ensure that the projects that they are working on are always unique, challenging their status quo every time. Our unique work culture has made us one of the world’s fastest-growing technology companies as recognized and featured by **The Economist**.

Our excellence in technical stewardship and service-offering expertise has facilitated our clients ranging from individual entrepreneurs to Fortune Global 500 – to explore new business opportunities, reduce their operational costs significantly and boost their revenues. Today, Globals enjoys a strong position in the industry as a high-performing leader through its technology innovation and remarkable domain expertise. Globals is a **CMMI Level 5** certified company.

**About the role**
------------------

Globals is a defence-technology and cybersecurity company building secure systems across enterprise, space, drone, and AI domains. We are looking for a Project Manager with 7–8 years of relevant experience to manage multiple customer projects in parallel and own delivery from initiation through customer acceptance and closure.

You will be the primary point of contact for customers, turning requirements into clear delivery plans and keeping stakeholders informed. Working with technical leads and cross-functional teams, you will balance competing priorities, resolve dependencies, and keep scope, schedules, budgets, and customer expectations aligned.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own multiple projects in parallel, with clear plans, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and acceptance criteria for each engagement.
* Lead customer kick-offs, progress reviews, and steering meetings; communicate status, decisions, risks, and next steps clearly and promptly.
* Coordinate technical teams, vendors, and business stakeholders; resolve resource conflicts and competing priorities across projects.
* Track schedules, effort, budgets, and delivery quality; identify variances early and drive corrective actions with accountable owners.
* Maintain risk, issue, dependency, and action logs; remove blockers and escalate with clear options and recommended next steps.
* Control scope changes by assessing impacts on effort, cost, and timelines, obtaining approvals, and updating agreed commitments.
* Maintain project reports and governance records; coordinate milestone sign-offs and invoicing readiness with internal teams.
* Drive customer acceptance, handovers, and closure; capture lessons learned and improve delivery practices across engagements.

  
  

### **Requirements**

**Must-have qualifications**
----------------------------

* 7–8 years of relevant project management or technology delivery experience, including ownership of customer-facing projects.
* Proven ability to manage several concurrent projects with different teams, timelines, and stakeholder expectations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including customer presentations, executive updates, and difficult conversations.
* Strong planning, resource coordination, budget tracking, risk management, and change-control skills.
* Working knowledge of Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery approaches, with practical use of Jira, Microsoft Project, or similar tools.
* Ability to translate technical updates into business implications, negotiate priorities, and drive actions to closure.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, IT, Business, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience in IT services or consulting, managing delivery for external customers.
* Exposure to cybersecurity, software development, cloud, or infrastructure projects.
* Experience coordinating distributed teams, delivery partners, and enterprise customers.
* Familiarity with statements of work, service commitments, and milestone-based billing.
* Experience creating project dashboards and improving delivery governance.
* Relevant certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, or Certified ScrumMaster.
* Prior exposure to defence, government, or other regulated customer engagements.

**Priority competencies**
-------------------------

The strongest candidates will demonstrate depth across the following areas, with particular emphasis on concurrent delivery and customer communication:

**Priority**

Managing multiple concurrent projects

**Critical**

Customer communication and relationship management

**Critical**

**High**

**Bonus**

### **Benefits**

**Why Globals**
---------------

You will help deliver technology and cybersecurity projects across enterprise and defence domains, working closely with engineering teams and customers. This role offers ownership of delivery outcomes and the opportunity to strengthen how Globals plans projects, coordinates teams, and builds lasting customer relationships.

title: Project Planning Manager
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

  

Could you be the full-time Project Planning Manager in Bangalore we’re looking for?

**Your future role**

Take on a new challenge and apply your project planning expertise in a cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside collaborative, innovative, and detail-oriented teammates.

You’ll play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless planning and execution of projects, from inception to closure, while supporting bid activities and providing critical reporting to both internal management and customers. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (engineering, procurement, installation, and testing & commissioning), lead project scheduling sessions, and ensure alignment with organizational objectives, and much more.

You’ll specifically take care of developing and maintaining comprehensive project programs, but also monitoring progress and ensuring alignment with customer and contractual requirements.

We’ll look to you for:

* Overseeing the development of logic-linked project programs, including engineering documentation, materials, and site activities planning.
* Monitoring project progress and identifying critical paths to ensure quality, cost, and delivery objectives are met.
* Coordinating functional activities and resolving bottlenecks to prevent project delays.
* Providing accurate reporting on Work Package progress to management and customers.
* Organizing and leading periodic project schedule sessions to review progress and address gaps.
* Maintaining robust interfaces between planning, finance, and project management for accurate reporting.
* Supporting the Planning Manager with business requests and auditing programs against procedures.
* Contributing to lessons learned and sharing best practices for continuous improvement.
* Preparing EVM, physical progress curves, and monthly/weekly reports for internal and customer submissions.
* Collaborating with project teams to ensure coordinated progress in design deliverables, procurement, installation, and testing & commissioning.
  

**All about you**

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.Tech/BE).
* 10-15 years of experience in project planning, scheduling, and monitoring within relevant fields or EPC projects.
* Proficiency in planning tools such as Primavera and MS Project.
* Working knowledge of project scheduling theory and methods.
* Basic understanding of time-related contractual obligations and penalties.
* Broad knowledge of railway industry products and technologies.
* Strong skills in MS Office tools.
* Curiosity and a drive to learn.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills; an effective team player.
* Structured and critical thinking skills with the ability to propose proactive solutions.
  

**Things you’ll enjoy** Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines.
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling.
* Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues.
* Contribute to innovative projects.
* Utilise our flexible working environment.
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries.
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning.
* Progress towards leadership roles in project planning or other functions.
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension).

  

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

  

**Important to note**

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

  

**Job Segment:** Project Manager, Procurement, Manager, Technology, Operations, Management

**Job Description**
-------------------

**The Future Begins Here**

At Takeda, we are leading digital evolution and global transformation. By building innovative solutions and future-ready capabilities, we are meeting the need of patients, our people, and the planet.

Bengaluru, the city, which is India’s epicenter of Innovation, has been selected to be home to Takeda’s recently launched Innovation Capability Center. Takeda is committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative workplace, where individuals are recognized for their backgrounds and abilities they bring to our company. We are continuously improving our collaborators journey in Takeda, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Here, you will feel welcomed, respected, and valued as an important contributor to our diverse team  
  
**About the Role:**

Drive integrated planning and delivery for prioritized initiatives supporting the MedEx transformation portfolio.

Translate priorities into executable roadmap, coordinated workplans and transparent governance.

**Key Accountabilities:**

**Program delivery and governance**

* Own the integrated roadmap, milestones, critical path, dependencies, RAID log, decisions and benefits plan across the MedEx portfolio.
* Run planning, governance and portfolio review cadences with clear decision requirements, quorum and documented outcomes.
* Coordinate delivery across GCM, Global Medical, Digital, Finance, HR, Procurement and external partners.
Operate scope and change control so baseline changes to scope, schedule or cost are assessed, approved and traceable.  

**Execution discipline and performance**

* Convert strategic priorities into scoped initiatives with owners, resource plans, acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes.
* Track delivery health against schedule, cost and quality baselines; resolve cross-workstream issues and escalate material risks early.
* Manage resource demand, capacity and vendor performance; maintain stakeholder and communication plans for each release.
Maintain clear documentation, status reporting and audit-ready traceability for leadership and governance forums.  

**Value, benefits and improvement**

* Support business cases, investment tracking and benefit realization against agreed KPIs and value targets.
* Standardize program templates, tooling and metrics; embed data- and AI-enabled delivery practices.
* Run retrospectives, capture lessons learned and continuously simplify portfolio execution.
Apply data- and AI-enabled delivery practices within enterprise data, privacy and AI-governance requirements.  

  

**Dimensions and Aspects:**

* **Technical expertise:** Applies program-management practices to manage roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, risks, resources, benefits, and change control.
* **Leadership:** Coordinates global, cross-functional teams and drives delivery through clear communication, governance, and follow-up.
* **Decision-making:** Recommends actions within agreed scope, resolves delivery issues, and escalates material risks and decisions requiring leadership input.
* **Interaction:** Partners with Medical, GCM, Digital, Finance, HR, Procurement, regional teams, and external vendors.
* **Innovation:** Improves portfolio visibility and execution through practical templates, tools, reporting, data, and AI-enabled practices.
* **Complexity:** Manages multiple interdependent workstreams, changing priorities, cross-geography teams, resource constraints, and competing delivery requirements.
* **Impact:** Enables timely, transparent, and disciplined delivery of the GCM transformation portfolio, supporting benefits realization and business continuity.
* **Scope:** Global portfolio scope; no direct reports; coordinates assigned resources, vendors, and budgets within approved authority.

**Qualifications:**

* **Experience**: 6-8 years leading programs or transformation delivery, including 2+ years running a multi-workstream portfolio in a global, matrixed or capability-center environment; Medical Affairs or life-sciences experience preferred.
* **Education**: Degree in business, life sciences, engineering or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
* **Certifications**: PMP, PRINCE2, PgMP or equivalent program certification preferred; Agile/SAFe and Lean Six Sigma exposure aplus.
* **Technical skills:** Integrated roadmap and dependency planning, RAID and change control, resource and capacity planning,benefits tracking, executive reporting; proficient with enterprise PPM and collaboration tooling.
* **Governance**: Ability to advance AI-enabled and agentic ways of working within scientific, quality and compliance controls.

**BENEFITS:**

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
**Overview**  

Are you excited about Artificial Intelligence (AI) and what it can do to transform our day-to-day processes and activities? Join the Trust & Integrity Protection team and help shape the future of Digital Asset compliance automation at scale.

As Microsoft deploys new AI agents and AI-enabled technology to transform Digital Asset review processes, we need dedicated ownership for the performance, quality, and continuous improvement of these capabilities.

As an AI Solution PM, Compliance Automation, you will oversee the health and effectiveness of AI agents supporting Digital Asset reviews, identify new AI automation opportunities, and create proof cases that can progress to full production deployment. You will partner with domain experts, compliance stakeholders, operations teams, engineering, and vendors to translate changing risk signals into agent improvements so review coverage continues to grow and quality continues to improve.

This role is a Technical Program Management opportunity based in Bangalore, India. The role requires strong program management fundamentals, data-driven decision making, technical judgment, stakeholder influence, and the ability to manage cross-functional work with minimal guidance across multiple features, workflows, and compliance risk areas.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

  
**Responsibilities**  

* Own program execution for AI-enabled Digital Asset review capabilities, including agent performance monitoring, issue triage, quality improvement planning, and readiness for launch and post-launch operations.
* Define and maintain success criteria, key performance indicators (KPIs), operational metrics, and telemetry needed to measure AI agent coverage, accuracy, review velocity, quality, risk reduction, and customer experience.
* Partner with risk domain experts to translate emerging risk signals, policy changes, and review findings into clear business requirements, evaluation criteria, backlog items, and prioritized improvement plans.
* Identify new AI and automation opportunities across the Digital Asset review lifecycle, develop hypotheses, evaluate feasibility and impact, and create proof cases that demonstrate readiness for production deployment.
* Coordinate cross-functional work across engineering, risk, compliance, operations, vendor teams, and business stakeholders to deliver improvements on schedule while managing dependencies, risks, tradeoffs, and stakeholder communications.
* Drive data-informed prioritization by analyzing review outcomes, agent performance trends, false positives, false negatives, escalations, feedback, and operational bottlenecks to recommend improvements that increase coverage and quality.
* Support solution design and implementation planning for multiple AI-enabled features or functional areas, ensuring requirements are clear, measurable, and aligned to privacy, security, Responsible AI, and business expectations.
* Develop and manage experimentation, testing, validation, and rollout plans for agent enhancements, including acceptance criteria, go/no-go recommendations, change management, documentation, and operational handoff.
* Create clear documentation, reporting, and stakeholder-ready narratives that explain agent performance, risks, opportunities, launch readiness, and business impact to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Contribute to program management best practices for compliance automation, including repeatable mechanisms for intake, prioritization, quality review, production readiness, operational support, and continuous improvement.

  
**Qualifications**

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Program Management, Compliance, Risk Management, or a related field AND 4+ years of experience in technical program management, product/program management, compliance technology, automation, operations, or related work; OR equivalent experience.
* Experience managing cross-functional technical programs, including requirements definition, prioritization, execution planning, dependency management, risk management, and stakeholder communications.
* Experience using data, metrics, KPIs, dashboards, or telemetry to evaluate program or product performance and drive measurable improvements.
* Experience working with AI, automation, workflow tooling, compliance systems, governance processes, or technology-enabled operations.
* Ability to translate ambiguous inputs into clear business requirements, success criteria, experiments, and implementation plans.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical and compliance concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AI agents, machine learning evaluation, prompt or agent quality assessment, model performance monitoring, automated testing, or production readiness for AI-enabled solutions.
* Experience supporting compliance functions, governance, or risk management.
* Experience developing proof-of-concept or proof-case work and converting validated opportunities into production-ready solutions.
* Experience with reporting and workflow tools such as Power BI, Excel, Power Automate, Azure DevOps, or similar systems used to manage backlogs, metrics, and operational performance.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders, resolve ambiguity, manage tradeoffs, and drive alignment across engineering, operations, compliance, and business teams.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. The KT PMO is responsible for coordinating and managing all Transition, Knowledge Transfer (KT)


planning and execution activities within a transition wave or BU/BF scope. The role ensures that KT


activities are structured, scheduled, tracked, and completed in line with transition milestones, enabling


GCM teams to achieve the operational readiness and capability required to deliver at steady state.

KT Planning \& Scheduling

* Support and maintain comprehensive KT plans aligned with transition wave timelines and milestones
* Support the Functional Transition leads and Transition Wave Managers on all aspects of transition
* Define KT schedules, maintain list of required SMEs, and coordinate participant availability across sending and receiving teams

Documentation \& Sign\-Off Management

* Maintain a central repository of KT documentation and supporting evidence

Experience

* Experience supporting knowledge transfer activities in transition, shared services, or GBS/GCC environments preferred
* Exposure to transition planning, process documentation, and operational readiness activities

* Strong project coordination and tracking skills, with ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously
* Ability to develop and maintain KT trackers, readiness dashboards, and structured governance reporting
* Proficiency in project tracking and collaboration tools
* Familiarity with transition methodologies, KT frameworks, and stage\-gate governance


Behavioral Competencies

* Highly organized with strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
* Clear and proactive communicator with strong interpersonal skills across diverse, global teams
* Results\-oriented mindset with strong attention to delivery commitments and accountability


Education

* Bachelor’s degree required


Languages

* Fluent in English

title: PMO Analyst
description:
**Bring more to life.**


Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?


At IDBS, one of Danaher’s 15\+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.


You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact– innovating at the speed of life.


At IDBS, we provide innovative software solutions and services that empower scientists and researchers to accelerate their discoveries, by helping them design, execute and orchestrate processes, manage, contextualize and structure their data and gain valuable insights throughout the drug lifecycle, from R\&D through manufacturing. As part of Danaher’s connected ecosystem, we partner closely with customers to solve their toughest challenges with greater speed and certainty. We work with 75% of the top 20 global biopharma companies\*. Join us at IDBS to continuously grow and make a real impact, working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about our mission and each other.

* Rank measured by Market Cap, Q2 2026\.


Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.


The **PMO Analyst** supports project governance, reporting, forecasting, data quality, audit readiness, and continuous improvement across a global portfolio of Life Sciences software\-as\-a\-service implementation projects. This internal\-facing role helps establish consistent ways of working, maintain trusted project data, strengthen delivery discipline, and apply artificial intelligence tools and agents to improve Project Management Office productivity and reporting quality.


This position is located onsite in Bangalore, India and is part of the Global Professional Services team. The role will report to a Professional Services leader and partner closely with Project Managers, implementation teams, and Finance across regions and time zones.

**In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**

* Support the planning, coordination, tracking, and closure of multiple concurrent software\-as\-a\-service implementation projects by maintaining accurate project plans, actions, RAID logs, milestone records, and delivery documentation.
* Coordinate project governance routines, including status reporting, meeting preparation, action and decision follow\-up, milestone tracking, documentation reviews, and adherence to standard delivery processes across Agile, waterfall, and hybrid delivery models.
* Maintain project and portfolio reporting by tracking delivery status, milestones, budget consumption, effort information, resourcing, utilization, risks, governance compliance, and overall delivery health.
* Support project forecasting and financial tracking by compiling and validating project inputs, monitoring variances against plan, and highlighting potential timeline, resource, billing, or revenue forecast risks for management review.
* Partner with Professional Services leaders, Project Managers, implementation teams and finance to support consistent project governance, reporting, communication and delivery coordination across global teams
* Define, maintain and analyze project health information using established metrics and reporting processes, identify trends or data gaps, and escalate delivery concerns to the appropriate project or leadership owner.
* Support PMO operations by maintaining and improving established templates, reporting methods, governance routines, audit records, and standard work, using approved AI\-enabled tools and automated workflows to improve data quality and process efficiency.

**The essential requirements of the job include:**

* 2\-3 years of experience supporting a Project Management Office, project coordination, delivery operations, or Professional Services team in a software, technology, consulting, or similar environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting tools, including the ability to use tools to analyze project data, identify trends, maintain data quality, and present insights clearly.
* Working knowledge of Agile, waterfall, and hybrid project delivery methodologies, with experience supporting governance, reporting, audit checks, or project health tracking.
* Experience using AI\-enabled or automation tools to improve reporting, data quality, analysis, or administrative workflows.
* The role works with global stakeholders and may occasionally require flexibility to participate in meetings outside standard local working hours.

**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

* A relevant project management, governance, Agile, or operational excellence certification or formal training, such as Certified Associate in Project Management, PRINCE2 Foundation, Agile or Scrum, or Lean Six Sigma
* Project management, resource planning, customer relationship management, professional services automation, reporting, or collaboration platforms such as Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Power BI, Jira, Confluence, Salesforce, NetSuite OpenAir, or Tableau
* Life Sciences software implementation or regulated delivery environments, including BioPharma, Good Practice requirements, laboratory information management systems, electronic laboratory notebooks, software\-as\-a\-service platforms, or cloud\-based informatics solutions
* Experience creating automated workflows or AI\-enabled agents to support reporting, analysis, or data quality activities.

**Travel, Motor Vehicle Record \& Physical/Environment Requirements:**

* Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 5% including occasional overnight travel


Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real\-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.


For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

* B.S. In Electrical Engineering or relevant discipline

Our Professional Services team sits at the center of Karat's largest and most strategic client relationships, turning signed contracts into successful, expanding partnerships through onboarding, delivery, and the ongoing work of proving Karat's value at scale.


### **What you will do**


As Senior Project Manager at Karat, you keep engagement work moving for one or more of the company's most strategic accounts. You partner day to day with an assigned Delivery Partner, as well as work alongside Solutions Engineers and Client Partners who round out the assigned account pod. This is a senior individual contributor role: you make judgment calls and resolve issues directly with client counterparts rather than simply routing them. As one of Karat's first dedicated Project Managers in this model, you'll also help shape what this role becomes as the team grows.


* Own and manage the project plan for your assigned account(s), including milestones, task tracking, and scheduling across internal and external stakeholders, and report clearly on delivery progress and account health for internal stakeholders.
* Serve as a day\-to\-day point of contact for client project managers and coordinators, building strong working relationships.
* Coordinate logistics for in\-person meetings, stakeholder syncs, executive business reviews, and account events, across US and India time zones.
* Own project\-related documentation, including statements of work, change orders, functional and technical design documents, and contract approval workflows.
* Support the Delivery Partner on operational execution: surface risks and blockers early, and recommend solutions.
* Triage day\-to\-day project tickets and issues, resolving what you can and looping in the Delivery Partner or Solutions Engineer as needed.
* Help build this practice as one of Karat's first dedicated Project Managers: create onboarding materials, documentation templates, and standard operating practices, and share lessons across accounts as the team grows.

### **The experience you will bring**


* 5\+ years managing complex program or project plans for enterprise clients, ideally including regulated industries like financial services
* Experience owning documentation\-heavy, multi\-stakeholder engagements, including statements of work, change orders, and technical design documents, not just task tracking

### **About Us**


CloudifyOps is a company with **DevOps** and **Cloud** in our DNA. CloudifyOps enables businesses to become more agile and innovative through a comprehensive portfolio of services that addresses hybrid IT transformation, Cloud transformation, and end\-to\-end DevOps Workflows.

  

We are a proud Advance Partner of Amazon Web Services and have deep expertise in Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform solutions.

  

We are passionate about what we do. The novelty and the excitement of helping our customers accomplish their goals drives us to become excellent at what we do.  

  



  

### **Job Description**


**W****ho we are**

  

CloudifyOps is an AI \& Digital Transformation partner. We pair over a decade of mission\-critical cloud and DevOps engineering with strategic AI consulting, custom AI development, and managed operations \- helping businesses modernize their IT infrastructure, optimize cloud operations, and accelerate software delivery through automation and best practices.

  

Beyond client services, we build our own products \- MIXIMO, Lens, and DevOptymize \- and run always\-on Cloud, AI and Site Reliability operations for global clients across FinTech, EdTech, Healthcare, Automotive and Media Tech.

 **Culture at CloudifyOps**

  

Working at CloudifyOps is a rewarding experience. We're built around five values \- **Ownership, Transparency, Learning, One Team, and Performance** \- and you'll feel them in how work actually gets done here, not just in a poster on the wall.

  

Great people, a work environment that thrives on creativity, a career path designed around feedback and progress \- as well as the opportunity to take on roles beyond a defined job description are just some of the reasons you should work with us.

 **About the Role**  

  

As an Associate Technical Project Manager, you will own the end\-to\-end delivery of customer projects across cloud migration, modernization, infrastructure, and AI engagements. You will work alongside Architects, Technical Leads, and Engineers to translate an approved solution into a planned, tracked, and governed delivery \- and you will be the primary point of contact the customer relies on for progress, risks, and decisions.  

This role sits at the intersection of technology and delivery governance. You are expected to understand the technical solution well enough to challenge estimates, spot dependencies early, and hold both the team and the customer to agreed scope, effort, and timelines.

 **Key Responsibilities** **Project Planning**

* Review project proposals to ensure in\-scope and out\-of\-scope items, effort and cost estimation, deliverables, assumptions, and the proposed architecture are clearly defined.
* Analyze project requirements and prepare or update project timelines, delivery methodology, RACI, milestones, and deliverables.
* Ensure use cases and test cases are clearly defined before the project is onboarded to the delivery team.
* Prepare the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) before implementation and review it with the Technical Lead.
* Establish timelines and milestones and plan delivery within the approved budget.

 **Technical Project Management**

* Develop a sound understanding of the technical deliverables and work closely with Architects and Technical Leads to identify and manage risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans.
* Regularly review the technical solution and implementation progress with the Technical Lead to ensure planned activities are completed within the agreed timeline.
* Track project scope, schedule, effort, dependencies, and deliverables to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and as per agreed scope.
* Assess project risks, develop risk mitigation strategies, and implement contingency plans to minimize the impact of potential issues.
* Identify project blockers and follow the defined escalation hierarchy for timely resolution.

 **Delivery Across Project Types**

* **Migration and cloud projects:** Manage end\-to\-end delivery of cloud migration, modernization, and infrastructure projects, tracking cloud\-specific activities, technical dependencies, risks, and milestones with Architects and Technical Leads.
* **Non\-migration technical projects:** Manage end\-to\-end delivery of AI PoC implementations, AI assessments, and similar engagements, ensuring requirements, use cases, test cases, technical deliverables, and timelines are clearly defined and aligned with the approved solution.
* Coordinate with the technical teams responsible for moving applications between Development, Test, Integration, and Production environments.
* Manage change requests across cloud migration activities and track all associated events to maximize system availability and avoid errors.

 **Customer \& Stakeholder Management*** Coordinate and conduct regular daily stand\-ups and customer meetings, and maintain meeting minutes, action items, expectations, and discussion points.
* Prepare and share weekly project status reports covering progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and next steps.
* Maintain effective communication and coordination between customers, Sales, Architects, Technical Leads, Engineers, and other stakeholders.
* Keep clients, executives, and external partners engaged throughout the project lifecycle to sustain involvement and satisfaction.

 **Project Governance \& Documentation**

* Maintain key project documentation, including WBS, RACI, risk and issue registers, meeting minutes, status reports, decision and action trackers, and project closure documents.
* Ensure project activities and deliverables remain aligned with the approved scope, timeline, effort, and customer expectations.
* Drive project closure activities and ensure required deliverables, customer confirmation or sign\-off, and closure documentation are completed.

 **Effort \& Commercial Management**

* Review team timesheets and effort utilization against approved project estimates, and maintain in line with agreed effort hours.
* Track project consumption and proactively highlight any effort or budget deviations.
* Obtain the final project consumption from the customer and coordinate with the Sales team for invoicing and partner\-center billing.

 **Team Leadership \& Reporting**

* Provide leadership and guidance to project teams, facilitate collaboration, resolve conflicts, and motivate team members to achieve project objectives.
* Drive difficult conversations with both customers and team members when a project needs to be brought back on track.
* Generate weekly and monthly reports aligned with the relevant metrics for each type of project \- for example, resource utilization, technical evaluation of team members, and customer success data points.

 **What You Bring** **Experience \& Technical Background**

* 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in a development or engineering environment across Cloud migrations, DevOps, AI or SRE.
* Hands\-on ownership of end\-to\-end delivery of platforms and products built on a modern technology stack (microservices, cloud, DevOps).
* Knowledge of cloud concepts, DevOps and AI principles and practices.
* Proficiency in Agile methodologies, applied to project management in cloud, DevOps and AI environments.
* Basic understanding of automation and scripting, security best practices, and Infrastructure as Code.

 **Core Skills \& Attributes**

* Strong leadership qualities to guide and motivate teams towards project success.
* Excellent communication skills to articulate project goals clearly, expectations, and progress to stakeholders, team members, and clients, supported by effective listening and negotiation skills.
* Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and resources effectively.
* Strong problem\-solving skills to identify issues, analyze alternatives, and implement appropriate solutions promptly.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and capable of adjusting plans and strategies as needed.
* Ability to maintain composure, stay focused, and handle pressure while keeping the project on track.

 **License / Certification**

* At least one of PSM, PMP, CSM, or a certification in any Agile project management methodology. SAFe certification is preferred.  

  

**What You Can Expect**

  

This is a delivery role with real ownership attached to it. Here is what the day\-to\-day looks like and what the role gives back.

* **Ownership from the start:** You will run projects end to end \- planning, governance, customer communication, and closure \- rather than supporting someone else's plan.
* **Technical breadth:** Direct exposure across cloud migration and modernization, infrastructure, managed operations, and AI engagements, delivered for global clients in FinTech, EdTech, Healthcare, Automotive, and Media Tech.
* **Access to senior expertise:** You will work daily with Architects, Technical Leads, and the Director \- Delivery, with solution reviews and escalation paths that build your technical judgment over time.
* **Customer\-facing exposure:** You will be the primary point of contact for customer stakeholders, which builds the communication and negotiation skills that shape a long\-term delivery career.
* **A defined path forward:** A structured performance and feedback framework, with clarity on what growth looks like in the Delivery function.
* **Scope beyond the job description:** Opportunities to contribute to pre\-sales, delivery process improvement, and internal governance as you build credibility.

 **Equal opportunity employer**

  

CloudifyOps is proud to be an equal opportunity employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, pregnancy, marital status, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, veteran status, or other protected category.

* Monitor project milestones, deliverables, and resource utilization.

**Job Description:**

Responsible for establishing baseline criteria to plan and schedule workload relative to various engineering projects.
  

Prepares project planning and scheduling status reports and recommends remedial actions. Carries out necessary
  

preplanning to examine scope of work and services, work breakdown structure, engineering quality and quantities,
  

financial and contractual obligations and division of responsibility to control and report on planning and scheduling
  

activities. Works with third parties to ensure plans are realistic and achievable; analyzes third party contractor
  

progress information. Prepares schedules for commissioning and start up. Assist the project control team in
  

establishing a project performance index. A Specialist Professional (P4\) is a recognized subject matter expert in job
  

area typically obtained through advanced education and work experience. Responsibilities typically include: Managing
  

large projects or processes with limited oversight from manager. Coaching, reviewing and delegating work to lower
  

level professionals. Problems faced are difficult and often complex


Instructions and guidelines
  

Ensures projects follow sound methodology and execution practices in accordance with internal
  

standard procedures. Ensures that an integrated schedule for the project’s entire scope of work is provided.
  

2\. Planning and scheduling
  

Analyzes project requirements with project team, checks that all essential work activities have been identified in sufficient detail to serve as a basis for developing realistic project schedules. Defines,
  

jointly with the project team, project work aligned to the cost breakdown structure, develops, and maintains properly linked, required role loaded/integrated, baseline and current schedules that pro\-vide time phased baseline, actual and forecast data for project. Monitors project progress and regularly analyzes project critical paths to ensure all critical path activities and project milestones are progressed to the plan, notifies
  

Project Managers of any deviations or scheduling issues, and provides
  

input for optimizing resources. When required prepares EOT Schedules and Schedule Analysis to support Project Team. Works together with Line Management Organization to resolve Resource Demand / Staffing
  

Conflicts. Issues progress reports, schedule updates and productivity data on a regular basis and as requested by customers and stakeholders.
  

3\. Cost, revenue and cash flow management
  

Supports the establishment of a baseline plan for cost and cash flow performance measurement.
  

Works with project team to define the necessary resources for project completion, evaluating the work breakdown structure and standard productivity. Where required – create As Sold reference
  

point in Project Control tool suite and generate Original Budget baseline. Reflect Variation Orders in the revised baseline.
  

4\. Change management
  

Works closely with engineering, construction, pre\-commissioning, commissioning, client and contractors to identify
  

potential changes in scope and quantifies the impact of each change in a timely fashion. Revise baseline in line with
  

the approved Variation Orders and Extension of Time request


5\. Risk management Works with project team to identify and assess the priority of project risks (e.g. schedule, cost and scope risks), and proposes mitigation plans. Analyzes impact of risk on the overall timeline and re\-sources.
  

6\. Procurement Integrates material resource requirements with project schedule and defines procurement activities and order lead times. Regularly communicates with Supply Chain Management team and updates schedules to ensure procurement activities take place in a timely way and lead times are optimized to meet schedule targets.
  

7\. Project reviews Participates in project reviews. Composes reports and updates all required project data in Project Controls and reporting systems for Management Information and Project Analysis. Communicates project progress and control issues to project management team.

Effectively communicates appropriate information to the Project Manager and other stakeholders in a timely manner and to achieve desired understanding.

with Hitachi Energy instructions and guidelines and are adequate to implement contractual agreements with Hitachi\-Energy customers.

title: Senior Manager-PMO (Bangalore - On Site)
description:
**1\. Core Mandate**


* Run the India hub PMO — governance, cadence, stage\-gates, RAID and reporting

Stand up and mature the hub operating model — ways of working, Dubai* India RACI, tooling and working rhythm — and onboard and ramp the team to steady\-state
* Break work down into activities and tasks and manage them to completion across all India workstreams
* Track what people are working on, against initiatives — timesheets, activity and utilisation, with a clear definition of productive\-vs\-available capacity, weekly capture and submission\-compliance
* Own the hub's delivery SLAs and quality standards — on\-time task completion, timesheet\-submission compliance, reporting timeliness and rework / quality — and drive throughput improvement
* Own comms and change management as a core part of the role
* Present the outputs — a standard reporting pack and dashboards to the leadership team on a fixed cadence
* Lead and develop the India team and safeguard the control, information\-security and quality environment


**2\. Key Responsibilities**


**A. PMO Governance \& Cadence**


* Establish and run the India governance cadence — stand\-ups, reviews, stage\-gates and escalations — aligned to the wider PMO rhythm and the RACI with the functional leads

Run the Dubai* India working rhythm — overlap\-window syncs, handoffs and cross\-side dependency management — so India work stays connected to the Dubai leads and no dependency stalls silently
* Operate a defined escalation path with explicit triggers (slippage, blocked dependency, capacity breach) into the PMO Lead and functional leads — surface early, with options
* Define and maintain PMO structure, standards and ways of working for the hub


**B. Planning, Work Breakdown \& Task Management**


* Run a structured intake for work entering the hub — capture, prioritise and assign against agreed capacity — holding the boundary to the Demand function
* Break initiatives down into activities and tasks with owners, plans and deadlines
* Manage the tasks to completion; track progress against plan, manage cross\-workstream and Dubai\-side dependencies, keep critical path and blockers visible, and drive corrective action


**C. Timesheets, Activity \& Utilisation Tracking**


* Define utilisation explicitly — productive / allocated time vs available capacity — and maintain the person\-level view against initiatives
* Own weekly timesheet capture and its data quality — drive on\-time, accurate submission (submission\-compliance %) and chase gaps
* Maintain a consistent activity / initiative taxonomy so booked time rolls up cleanly to initiatives and reporting; flag over\- and under\-utilisation (portfolio capacity\-vs\-demand sits with the Demand function)


**D. Comms \& Change Management**


Run the internal hub comms rhythm — stand\-ups, updates, onboarding comms — and the Dubai* India information flow, so both sides always hold the same picture
* Drive and evidence adoption of new ways of working — track uptake and address resistance, not just roll out


**E. Reporting \& Visibility (Presenting the Outputs)**


* Maintain a single source of truth on India activity, delivery and risk
* Publish a standard hub reporting pack on a fixed cadence — tasks / delivery status, utilisation, RAID, SLA / throughput and change adoption — under a defined leadership reporting contract (what, when, format)
* Build and maintain the dashboards (e.g. Power BI / Monday.com views) that give leadership self\-serve visibility between reporting cycles — no surprises


**F. Team Leadership, Control \& Information Security**


* Lead, coordinate and develop the India team; local line management, onboarding, ramp and capability uplift
* Own access provisioning / de\-provisioning (joiner\-mover\-leaver), data classification and handling, endpoint / remote\-access and clean\-desk standards, and confidentiality / NDA compliance — aligned to DAMAC information\-security policy; target zero data incidents
* Own coverage and continuity (key\-person and BCP) to manage offshore attrition risk, and maintain the delivery\-quality environment


**3\. Key Outcomes**


* A well\-run India\-hub PMO with structured governance and ways of working
* Hub stood up / matured to steady\-state on the agreed operating model and timeline
* Work broken into tasks and tracked to completion across all India workstreams
* Clear visibility of activity, utilisation and delivery for the leadership team
* Hub SLAs met — on\-time task completion, timesheet\-submission compliance, reporting timeliness and quality within target
* Comms and change well\-managed; new ways of working adopted
* A well\-led, controlled and compliant hub with zero data\-security incidents


**4\. Candidate Profile**


### **Experience**


* 8–10 years in PMO / programme management, transformation delivery or capability\-center / delivery\-hub leadership (Senior Manager level)
* Direct experience standing up and running an offshore / nearshore delivery hub or capability center (GCC / GDC) — mobilisation through steady\-state
* Strong PMO background — governance, planning, work breakdown, tracking, utilisation and reporting; proven leadership of distributed teams across locations and cultures


**Capabilities**


* PMO governance, cadence and structured ways of working
* Work breakdown, planning, intake and task / dependency management
* Timesheet / activity and utilisation tracking (productive\-vs\-available, submission compliance)
* Comms and change management with measured adoption
* Reporting and dashboarding — presenting outputs to leadership
* Hands\-on with work\-management and timesheet tooling (e.g. Monday.com, Jira, MS Project / Planner, Smartsheet or Clarity) and dashboarding (Power BI)
* People leadership, cross\-cultural stakeholder management, and working knowledge of information\-security / data\-handling for offshore teams


**AI, Automation \& Digital Tools (Group standard)**


* Practical GenAI skills — day\-to\-day use of large\-language\-model assistants (e.g. ChatGPT / Copilot\-class tools) to accelerate analysis, drafting and problem\-solving.
* Cowork and agent\-based / workflow\-automation tools.
* Power Automate and low\-code / no\-code automation.
* Automation skill sets applied to the function.


**5\. Behavioral Traits**


* Structured and disciplined (PMO\-minded)
* Builds structure from ambiguity (mobiliser)
* Excellent communicator
* Transparent and proactive
* Accountable
* A people\-first leader who helps the team


**6\. Success Definition**



A well\-governed India hub — stood up on a clear operating model and run on PMO discipline — work broken into tasks and tracked to completion, timesheets and utilisation visible, SLAs met and data handled securely, comms and change managed, and clear outputs presented to leadership so they always know exactly what is happening and delivery lands on plan.

**Location: Hyderabad/Bangalore**

* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of large, complex programs across multiple teams and stakeholders.

* Drive alignment between program objectives, business priorities, and delivery outcomes across geographies.
* Identify, escalate, and resolve risks and blockers with speed and precision — no bureaucratic padding.
* Build delivery dashboards and reporting that give leadership genuine signal, not false comfort.

**Qualifications:**

title: GSI Services Program Manager
description:
### **GSI Service Delivery Program Manager**

  

**Location:** Bangalore, India


### **Job summary:**


We are seeking a highly skilled and customer\-focused Services Program Manager to develop a post\-sales enablement and service\-delivery quality framework for Rubrik’s Global System Integrator (GSI) partners. Success in this role guarantees consistent and successful service delivery from Rubrik’s largest and most complex GSI partners to ensure customer success, satisfaction, and retention worldwide. Pro\-active and assertive development of the partner services relationships is a critical success factor for this role. It is both strategic and tactical and requires clear operational oversight, strong partner advocacy, and an ability to incent and reward top performance from Rubrik SMEs at all levels within the partners’ organizations. The ideal candidate understands how to work effectively with the Partner’s organization in collaboration with Rubrik’s Sales and Service Delivery teams to make Rubrik the preferred vendor for easy enablement and adoption of Rubrik best practices to deliver high value and margin\-rich services to their largest and most complex customers.


The GSI Services Program Manager is a critical contributor in the Partner Services Operations team within Rubrik’s Global Customer Success organization. Partner Services Operations enables partners to deliver post\-sales support and services to their customers using reliable and innovative systems, processes and programs that ensure a high level of Customer Satisfaction with minimal dependence on Rubrik. The ideal candidate will have strong technical acumen, excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, and a passion for collaborating with and advocating for partners for the benefit of our mutual customers.

  

### **Key Responsibilities:**


* **Program Leadership \& Management:** Lead and coordinate a scalable high\-growth engine of post\-sales support and professional services GSI engineers. Motivate this strategic workforce to achieve high Rubrik standards in product knowledge and service quality.
* **Partner Collaboration:** Build and maintain strong relationships with GSI partners and their Rubrik account teams, acting as the primary point of contact for post\-sales service issues, escalations, and proactive management of a seamless hand\-off from sales to services. Must be able to navigate and present to all management levels within the partner and Rubrik organization.
* **Customer Satisfaction:** Maintain strong customer focus to ensure all managed partners are delivering world\-class customer services, in collaboration with Rubrik, by measuring and monitoring customer satisfaction.
* **Training \& Enablement:** Facilitate and track role\-based training and certification to GSIs that ensures they are well\-equipped to deliver services aligned with Rubrik’s company standards, in partnership with Rubrik University, Rubrik Sales, and Global Customer Success.
* **Process \& Quality Improvement:** Implement and refine processes for support and professional services delivery, promoting best practices, scalability, and eliminating friction and inefficiencies.
* **Metrics \& Reporting:** Develop and maintain program KPIs, track performance metrics, and prepare regular reports for executive leadership and stakeholders. Facilitate Services QBRs to ensure continuous improvement on both sides of the partnership. Analyze program quality metrics to correctly assess and incent high partner performance, while requiring non\-performers to improve or exit the program.
* **Partner Advocacy:** Comprehensively understand the partners’ go\-to\-market strategy, global support structure, and service delivery plan; document and present partner’s approach to internal key stakeholders as an advocate for what the partners need from Rubrik to be successful.
* **Support Oversight**: Provide oversight on partner’s open support cases and product gaps, to ensure timely resolution and appropriate resourcing and visibility within Rubrik. Facilitate resolution for any customer complaints regarding partner\-delivered services.
  

### **ABOUT YOU:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related technical field; advanced degree preferred.
* 10\+ years of experience in program management, operations, technical support, or professional services, in a customer\-facing role at an enterprise technology solution provider.
* Strong technical background and aptitude in Networking, Storage, Backup and Recovery, Cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP etc.), and Hypervisors (VMware, Hyper\-V, etc.). Cyber Security experience is desired.
* Demonstrated experience working with GSIs or large multi\-regional channel partners. Quickly understands the business issues, data challenges, and both the commercial and services aspects of strategic partnerships within global service delivery teams.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with excellent communication and presentation ability, specifically to summarize complex product issues into clear executive summaries.
* Strong project management background, with demonstrated success coordinating multiple programs, workstreams, and people toward common, measurable objectives.
* Highly detail\-oriented with strong analytical skills, including hands\-on experience analyzing customer data to facilitate data\-driven decisions and to develop executive presentations. Experience with Salesforce, Atlassian, and Tableau reporting and data preferred.
* Motivated, proactive self\-starter with a customer\-centric mindset, focused on delivering measurable outcomes from cross\-functional teams, including those outside direct influence.
* Able to work independently in a fast\-paced growth environment.
* Able to travel to other locations and customer sites on occasion as required.
* Able to adjust work hours to overlap with USA and EMEA business hours as required.


**Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation**
----------------------------------------------------------------------


Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real\-time guardrails, fine\-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes.

----------------------


At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.

### **Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:**


* Our Company: We are committed to building a merit\-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.
* Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.
