**Job Title**
 Assistant Project Manager
   

  

**Job Description Summary**
 The role will require close coordination with the Client, PMC, consultants, contractors, design teams, procurement teams and site execution teams to ensure that project milestones are achieved within the approved project schedule. Having strong hands\-on expertise in Primavera P6, construction sequencing, progress measurement, critical path analysis, delay analysis and schedule reporting.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About The Role:**
* We are looking for an experienced Planning Engineer with around 10 years of experience in construction planning and project controls to be based in Bangalore.
* The candidate will be responsible for developing, maintaining and controlling project schedules, monitoring contractor performance, identifying schedule risks and delays, and providing timely recommendations for corrective and recovery measures.
* Develop and maintain the Project Master Schedule in Primavera P6\.
* Establish appropriate WBS, activity coding, calendars, relationships, milestones and critical path.
* Develop baseline, detailed execution, procurement, design and commissioning schedules.
* Integrate design, approvals, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning activities.
* Review contractor baseline schedules for logic, sequencing, durations, resources and achievability.
* Ensure alignment of contractor schedules with overall project milestones.
* Develop detailed L2/L3/L4 schedules as required by the project.
* Prepare and maintain 2\-week, 4\-week and monthly look\-ahead schedules.
* Identify interface activities and constraints affecting project progress.
* Monitor actual progress against the approved baseline schedule.
* Collect and validate progress information from site teams and contractors.
* Carry out weekly and monthly schedule updates.
* Analyse planned vs. actual progress and identify slippages.
* Track critical and near\-critical activities.
* Monitor key project milestones and sectional completion dates.
* Identify potential delays at an early stage and escalate them to the Project Manager.
* Ensure that reported progress is supported by actual site achievement.
* Prepare and monitor manpower histograms and resource loading.
* Review contractor manpower and equipment deployment against planned requirements.
* Monitor productivity against planned norms.
* Identify resource shortages affecting critical activities.
* Prepare resource\-based recovery plans where required.
* Monitor material and equipment requirements against project milestones.
* Coordinate with design consultants to track drawing and document deliverables.
* Monitor design approvals against construction requirements.
* Integrate procurement schedules with the construction programme.
* Track long\-lead items and ensure delivery dates are aligned with site requirements.
* Highlight delays in design approvals, material procurement and statutory approvals that may impact the programme.
* Review and comment on contractor schedules and programmes.
* Conduct regular planning meetings with contractors and site teams.
* Challenge unrealistic activity durations, sequencing and progress claims.
* Ensure contractors submit updated schedules and recovery programmes on time.
* Monitor contractor commitments against agreed action plans.
* Provide planning inputs during commercial and contractual discussions.
* Maintain a clear record of delay events, instructions, approvals and their schedule impact.
* Maintain a schedule risk and constraint register.
* Identify activities with potential impact on project completion.
* Carry out schedule risk assessments and mitigation planning.
* Support cost and commercial teams by providing schedule information for forecasting and change management.
* Analyse the schedule impact of variations and change orders.
* Support project forecasting and expected completion\-date assessments.
* Ensure schedule changes are properly documented and traceable.


**About You**
* B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution.
* Post Graduate qualification in Construction Management / Project Management will be an advantage.
* Primavera P6 certification will be preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in construction planning/project controls.
* Should have substantial experience in preparing and managing construction programmes rather than only updating schedules.
* Experience with a PMC/Client/Consultant organisation will be preferred.
* Experience in reviewing contractor programmes and delay claims will be an advantage.
* The ideal candidate will be a hands\-on construction planning professional, not merely a Primavera operator. He/she should be capable of independently analysing a project programme, identifying why the project is slipping, determining the impact on the critical path, developing recovery options and presenting clear recommendations to the Project Manager/Client.
* Experience with major contractors such as L\&T, Shapoorji Pallonji, Tata Projects, NCC, Afcons, Brigade, Prestige or similar organisations, or experience with a reputed PMC/consultancy, will be preferred.

* Conducting UAT and providing launch support to ensure business readiness for new system deployments

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Manage the planning, execution, and delivery of reconciliation programs, ensuring timely resolution of financial discrepancies and compliance with established processes of Nodal and Escrow accounts
* Conduct deep dives into transaction data and financial metrics to identify anomalies, root causes, and opportunities for process improvements


\-Monthly substantiation\- Daily identification, deep dive, escalation and closure of exceptions by partnering with various world\-wide teams  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders including finance, operations, and technology teams to align on project goals, mitigate delivery risks, and drive consensus on solutions
* Lead internal and external and regulatory audits of these accounts
* Advise business teams in launch of new products and capabilities w.r.t potential impact on these accounts
* Closely work with accounting and finance to ensure accurate representation in entity accounts
* Drive continuous improvement and automation
* Ensure ongoing compliance with guidelines and become backup of processes to ensure business continuity.

  

A day in the life  

Each day brings new challenges in transaction settlement operations. You might start your morning analyzing settlement data to identify reconciliation gaps, then transition to facilitating a working session with accounting and technology partners to resolve a complex discrepancy. Your afternoons could involve updating stakeholders on program status, documenting process improvements, or diving into financial metrics to surface potential risks before they impact operations. You'll work closely with team members who value analytical rigor and collaborative problem\-solving.  

  

About the team  

The Transaction Settlement Operations team plays a critical role in maintaining the financial integrity of Amazon's transactions. We work at the intersection of finance, technology, and operations, solving complex reconciliation challenges at scale.  

  

Our culture values precision, innovation, and collaboration. We're building the future of settlement operations by implementing automated solutions and refining processes that handle millions of transactions. Join a team where your analytical skills and program management expertise will directly contribute to operational excellence and financial accuracy.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2\+ years of program or project management experience
* Master's degree or equivalent
* 3\+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
* Experience in MS Access and SQL
* Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
* Experience working in an analytical environment with cross\-functional teams
* Chartered Accountant (CA) qualification preferred.

title: Principal Technical Program Manager
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.



The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co\-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.


* *Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025\. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.*
**An overview of this role**



As a Technical Program Manager on GitLab's all\-remote R\&D PMO team, you will own complex, end\-to\-end programs that are central to our AI\-powered DevSecOps strategy. You will drive high\-priority initiatives across product, engineering, data, and security teams, transforming strategic vision into executable plans that deliver innovative capabilities like the GitLab Duo Agent Platform and next\-generation developer tools. You will work closely with executive leaders and cross\-functional stakeholders, serving as the bridge between strategy and execution through clear communication, proactive risk management, and structured program delivery. In your first year, you will independently lead strategic programs, driving predictable execution, thoughtful tradeoffs between quality and speed, and transparent stakeholder alignment.


**Some examples of our projects:**


* Leading the GitLab Duo Agent Platform from GA through enterprise adoption, including customer onboarding, support models, and billing integration for AI\-driven capabilities
* Delivering data\-intensive platform initiatives that enhance developer productivity and enterprise analytics capabilities
* Driving infrastructure modernization and scalability programs that support our growing customer base
* Orchestrating security and compliance initiatives that maintain our industry\-leading DevSecOps standards


**What you will do**


* Lead end\-to\-end technical programs across product, engineering, data, and security, from initial scope through launch and continuous improvement
* Collaborate closely with executive leaders and senior stakeholders to translate strategic vision into actionable roadmaps and align on priorities and tradeoffs
* Coordinate distributed teams across time zones using strong asynchronous communication, providing structure, clarity, and consistent status updates
* Develop and maintain comprehensive program plans, proactively identifying and mitigating risks and dependencies while facilitating decisions that balance speed, quality, and customer impact
* Partner with customer success and cross\-functional teams to refine communication plans, and operational workflows
* Champion GitLab's values and culture within programs, fostering collaborative excellence, continuous improvement, and innovation


**What you will bring**


* Proven experience leading technical program initiatives in product, engineering, data, or security environments, with demonstrated success delivering complex programs from inception through scaled adoption
* Demonstrated ability to define strategy and create clarity within extreme ambiguity
* Strong background in SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or DevOps technology companies, with ability to quickly master the GitLab platform and AI/ML initiatives
* Proven experience influencing and driving impact at a division and company\-wide scale, affecting market position and revenue
* Excellence in cross\-functional leadership, with experience partnering with engineering, product, security teams and engaging effectively with senior and C\-level stakeholders
* Outstanding communication skills, including asynchronous collaboration, executive reporting, and the ability to translate technical complexity into clear business impact
* Track record of success in fast\-paced, dynamic environments with evolving technical requirements and market opportunities
* Strong facilitation and influence skills, with ability to drive consensus across diverse stakeholder groups while building trust through transparency and delivery excellence
* Expertise in high\-level stakeholder management, including masterful communication with Executive Boards and enterprise Customers
* Collaborative leadership style aligned with GitLab's values, including respect, openness to feedback, and commitment to team success
* Proven track record of redefining organizational operations and serving as an escalation point to resolve highly complex, enterprise\-level challenges
* Welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds, including those with consulting, enterprise technology, or technical leadership experience who have owned outcomes and delivered transformational initiatives
* Ability to act as a visionary leader, shaping R\&D direction and fostering technical excellence across the organization


**About the team:** The Technical Program Management team sits within GitLab's R\&D Program Management Office and drives product, engineering, data, and security initiatives across our AI\-powered DevSecOps platform. You will join our growing, distributed team of Technical Program Managers currently spanning North America and Europe. We own the end\-to\-end delivery of complex, cross\-functional programs including AI platform capabilities, enterprise customer initiatives, and strategic technology transformations. As an all\-remote team, we excel at asynchronous communication to coordinate across time zones while partnering closely with executive leaders and stakeholders to deliver business\-critical outcomes.

#### **How GitLab Supports Full\-Time Employees**


* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well\-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation \& Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave


Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.



**Country Hiring Guidelines:** GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location\-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
